semiconductor_relevance: High — ORC Manufacturing specializes in manufacturing equipment for semiconductor device production and inspection.
summary: ORC Manufacturing is a specialist manufacturer established in 1968, focusing on advanced equipment for semiconductor device manufacturing and inspection. Their expertise includes technologies for electronic circuit boards and liquid crystal substrates, as well as direct exposure equipment for next-generation electronic circuit formation.
capabilities: Lithography systems for wafer level packaging

regional_presence.Japan: The company will be exhibiting at SEMICON JAPAN for the first time, indicating a strategic focus on the Japanese market.
